strings.jp:
焔帝ガルカーサ…!
貴方を討ちます!
strings.en:
Flame Emperor Gulcasa...!
I will defeat you!

strings.jp:
貴様の覚悟を見せてもらおう!
かかって来るがいい!
strings.en:
Show me your resolve!
Come at me!

strings.jp:
み、見事だ……王女よ…
貴様の覚悟、見せて貰った…ぞ……
strings.en:
S-splendid... Princess...
I have seen... your resolve...

strings.jp:
お父様…お母様……
仇は討ったわ……!
strings.en:
Father... Mother...
I have avenged you...!

strings.jp:
…でも、何故かしら……?
この悲しみと…空しさは……
strings.en:
...But why...? Why do I
feel this sorrow... this void...

strings.jp:
諦めなさい、ガルカーサ!
勝負はつきました
strings.en:
Give up, Gulcasa!
The match is decided.

strings.jp:
その程度の力で俺を倒せると
思うなッ!
strings.en:
Do not think power like
that can defeat me!
